tools.name: get_public_profile
tools.description: Use this first for a summary of Sudhanva Narayana. Returns his name, job title, employer, location, specialization, skills, and contact email as JSON. Set include_links to false to leave out his profile URL and social links.

tools.name: list_published_articles
tools.description: Use this to find Sudhanva's technical writing on ML infrastructure, inference, and Kubernetes. Returns posts with title, summary, tags, dates, and URL, newest first. Filter by tag. To read one post, use get_published_article.

tools.name: get_published_article
tools.description: Use this when you know an article slug, for example from list_published_articles. Returns that one post with its title, summary, category, tags, dates, and URL as JSON, or an error when no post has that slug.

tools.name: list_case_studies
tools.description: Use this for evidence of Sudhanva's production ML work. Returns each published case study with its title, summary, verified proof points, technologies, and URL as JSON.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_public_profile, list_published_articles, get_published_article, list_case_studies · Private data: get_public_profile · Public sink: get_public_profile, list_published_articles, get_published_article.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_public_profile, list_published_articles, get_published_article, list_case_studies · Private data: get_public_profile · Public sink: get_public_profile, list_published_articles, get_published_article

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_public_profile" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
